note: Pass thresholds. They come from the verification plan. v2 adds the headroom gate for generator v4. Committed before any v4 run. Do not change after a run to make a result pass. v3 adds the litm block (lost in the middle, phrasing, auto-recall), committed before any run of probe design 2. v4 adds H1n, H6, H7 and the design-3 settings, committed before any run of probe design 3. v5 adds the audit fixes (null-control margin, H7 ceiling, design-3 controls, pilot stop rule as fork counts), committed before any run of probe design 3. v6 (round 5): the K label depends on the data (fork_rule_line), the full run is V3, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER is set. v7 adds the proof block (the proof test, run.sh proof), committed before any proof data exists.

primary_comparisons.name: B minus A at N=10, all types
B minus A at N=30, all types
B minus A at N=10, type X

headroom_rule: discriminative at N = (oracle accuracy minus arm A accuracy at N, scored types) >= headroom_min_points. If not, the gain verdict at that N is 'BENCHMARK TOO EASY at this N: no claim either way'.
zero_parse_gate: arm Z parse rate is INFO only; a Z parse failure counts as wrong

litm.note: Pre-registered before any data. A hypothesis that fails stays in the report. Do not change after a run.
litm.h1_note: H1 prints 'TOO EASY: no claim' if the mean of the start and end accuracy of arm A (no compaction, cued) is above h1_ceiling_max_accuracy. H1 uses the mean of the start rate and the end rate, not pooled items.
litm.h2_label: expected, not blind; mixes compaction with session length
litm.h5_label: plumbing check, true by construction: the hook trigger depends only on the cue words of the probe text

nc_validity.note: A no-compaction session is valid only if the last-turn context (input + cache read tokens) is at least this share of nc_estimate_tokens, the transcript has no cleared-tool-result marker, and it has no compaction.

litm.h1n_note: H1n: the H1 rule on non-literal probes (arm A, no compaction), same thresholds and same ceiling.
litm.h6_note: K minus B search rate (used_lookup) on neutral probes, no compaction: point above 0 and CI lower bound above 0. Stop rule: if the pilot shows no higher search rate for K, stop and remove the levers.

design3.filler: pasted documents in user turns, one small task each (not graded)
design3.no_compaction: one main session for each seed, run as arm A; arms A, B, R and K fork it at the probe point with their own settings. B tests the startup injection only, R adds auto-recall, K adds the MCP tool, and the recall rule line only if the preflight shows it in the K forks (fork_rule_line true).

litm.null_control_note: Null control (no compaction, cued): PASS if |B minus A| is at most this many points and the 95% interval holds 0. Else the harness has an arm effect without the core handoff: no claim from arms R or K until the cause is found.
litm.h7_note: H7 prints 'TOO EASY: no claim' if the accuracy of arm B (no compaction, neutral) is above h7_ceiling_max_accuracy.
litm.d3_controls_note: Design 3, no compaction: arm O (all plant turns, no filler) must score at least d3_oracle_min_accuracy on every phrasing (the probe is answerable at zero distance); arm Z (no history) must score at most d3_amnesia_max_accuracy (the answer cannot be guessed). If not, do not read that phrasing.

pilot_stop_rule.note: Pilot = litm3-pilot, 2 dev seeds. The pilot gives counts, not intervals. Go to the full run only if ALL hold; else stop.
pilot_stop_rule.forks_per_arm_phrasing_nocompact_note: 2 seeds x 5 types = 10 probe forks for each of arms A, B, R, K and each of the 3 phrasings; a class with fewer forks is a harness fault
pilot_stop_rule.h6_point_note: K search rate minus B search rate on neutral probes, no compaction: point estimate above 0 (no interval claim with 2 seeds), computed on at least 10 forks per arm

litm.k_label_rule: If every K no-compaction fork has the recall rule line in its transcript (fork_rule_line true): K = R + recall rule line + MCP tool. Otherwise: K = R + MCP tool. The report prints the label from the data (out k_label).
litm.full_run: litm3-full-v3 is the default full run (23 seeds; compaction: A and B to N=30, R and K to N=10). litm3-full-v5 (no R, K at N=10 only) and litm3-full (V1, as designed) stay available.

design4.note: Pre-registered before any design-4 data. Design 4 changes only the no-compaction condition. Do not change after a run, except the pick, which is committed after the calibration and before the full run.

L3.lures: 1 reject after the last update, 1 undo

L4.lures: 2 rejects, 1 undo, 1 scoped after the last update; family values share the first 9 characters

design4.position: the third that holds the chain (tight chains)

metrics.M3: M2 and replaced as an exact set

gates.note: O: at least o_min_accuracy for each level, phrasing and metric. Z: at most z_max_accuracy. The offline 'last mention wins' solver: at most solver_max_accuracy_l3_l4 on M1 at L3 and L4, applied to the mean over the seeds of the run, for each level (not for each seed). Arm A above the ceiling is TOO EASY, below the floor TOO HARD.

calibration.pick_order: metrics M1, M2, M3; for each metric levels from L1 up; the first (metric, level) with arm A (phrasings pooled) in the band, O at least pick_o_min and Z at most pick_z_max
calibration.escalation: if arm A is above 80% in every cell, add L5 (k 16, family 4) once; if still above 80%, stop: Sonnet has no loss here. Report it.
calibration.o_below_note: If O is below 95% where A is in the band, the loss is interference at zero distance. Report it, but not as lost in the middle.
calibration.record: record the thinking setting of the run

pick.note: committed after the calibration (design4.py decide <run-id>) and before the full run

design4.h8_note: H8: arm A, L1 minus L4, M1, at least +15 points, CI lower bound above 0.
design4.h9_note: H9: at least 60% of the wrong answers of arm A (abstains excluded) are stale, lure or sibling values.
design4.h10_note: H10: O minus A at least headroom_min_points (15).
design4.h12_17_registered: 2026-11-22, F79, before any data of arms G and P. G = K + F77 (block) + F80 (inject); P = K + F78. Action probes (a task with no question, the fork writes a file) are the primary cell of H13 and H17.
design4.h12_note: H12 trigger: in G at least 90% of the non-literal probe items, and the same for neutral, got the history: the guard fired or the model searched (model_search).
design4.h13_note: H13 gain: G minus K on action probes (primary) is at least +10 points with the interval lower bound above 0 (M1, primary level, paired by seed). The same statistic on non-literal probes is reported as H13n. No claim if K is above 95% (TOO EASY).
design4.h14_note: H14 harm: G minus K on cued probes is at least -2 points. The share of answers that were right before the check and became wrong (at most 3%) needs the first reply, which the rows do not hold: it is reported as not measured.
design4.h15_note: H15 false fire: on control probes (facts stated one time, type CT) G fires in at most 10% of the forks. The real-transcript replay (run.sh retrieval-gate --replay) stays at or below 5% of the stops.
design4.h16_note: H16 not fitted: in the free-form cell (rows with free_form true) the fire rate is at least 80% of the fixed-form rate and the gain G minus K is at least half of H13. With plain-word keys, a fire rate below 25% limits the claim to identifier-shaped facts (not computed here: read it from the rows by hand).
design4.h17_note: H17 autonomous action (the owner's main case): G minus K on action probes is at least +10 points with the lower bound above 0, and the guard fired in at least half of the G action items.
design4.p_leak_note: P must equal K on non-literal probes: a P gain with the lower bound above 0 shows a leak (HARNESS LEAK).
design4.h11_note: H11 harm guard: R minus B stale-plus-lure error rate on cued probes, paired by seed (same bootstrap draws). HARM if the lower bound of the interval is above 0. Else OK.
design4.h1_primary_note: H1 primary pools the three phrasings (the rule and the ceiling are unchanged). H1c (cued), H1s (neutral) and H1n (non-literal) are secondary.
design4.pick_rules_note: The pick needs arm A at 45% to 90% in the picked cell for each phrasing, Z rows (no rows is NO DATA), and for M2 and M3 an alt rate below 10%.
design4.k_note: K's gain is an upper bound: fixed sentence forms with the key in backticks make a search by key almost an oracle.
design4.kept: H1 and its secondary forms use the primary cell. H6 and H7 and the null control are kept.

proof.types: R D X S E C M
proof.probes: cued, compaction condition, refused forks left out
proof.validity_gates: fresh-control F, oracle O, amnesia Z, parse rate, refused forks, missed checkpoints (the values above), and 4 seeds with A and B data at N=1 and N=10. A gate that does not pass makes the verdict INVALID, not FAIL.
proof.note: Pre-registered before any proof data. P1 (loss): A at N=1 minus A at N=10 >= p1_min_drop_points (pooled) and A at N=10 below A at N=1 in at least p1_min_seeds seeds. P2 (fix): B minus A at N=10 >= p2_min_gain_points (pooled), the 95% bootstrap lower bound over seeds above p2_ci_lower_above, and B >= A at N=10 in at least p2_min_seeds seeds. Do not change after a run.
